children: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro signed an executive order banning nondisclosure agreements between state agencies under the governor's jurisdiction and data-center companies. "Every Household in This Rural Town Receives $10,000 if a Data Center Gets Built," at 7 p.m. ET on Sept. 27, incorrectly said the ban was between local governments and data-center companies.
